maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from selling new annuities, life policies and pension risk transfer contracts, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Annuity and life insurance premiums are paid by individuals and corporate pension plans, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling annuities, life insurance and pension risk transfer through agents and advisors, not regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Long-term annuity, life and pension contracts provide guaranteed retirement income; switching risks surrender penalties, lost benefits and tax costs.
